column1: ## Rating criteria were fixed IN WRITING BEFORE any input was run, so that a
## disappointing result could not be reclassified into a better one:
##   PASS     every piece of information in the input is present in the output
##            AND correctly structured: columns carry real names where the
##            input supplies them, values sit under the right column, prose is
##            not sliced one-column-per-word, nothing is dropped.
##   PARTIAL  structure is broadly right but something is lost or mis-shaped:
##            a header not applied, a line dropped, a value split or merged.
##   FAIL     the output MISREPRESENTS the input: values under the wrong column
##            names, a table shredded, or a substantial part missing.
## Judged on DEFAULT mode — what `glean` does with no flags. The `multi` column
## records whether `--multi` does better, worse, or the same.
## This is a self-assessment by the same agent that wrote the engine. It is a
## screen, not a verdict; the human review rounds remain the real measure.
